question: Where was the Blue Pinkgill mushroom spotted in Telangana?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Kagaznagar forest division**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Blue Pinkgill Mushroom Sighted in Telangana's Kagaznagar Forest Division.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Blue Pinkgill mushroom** (Entoloma hochstetteri) spotted in **Kagaznagar forest division**, **Telangana**.

 
 
• 
 
The **Blue Pinkgill** is native to **New Zealand** and is recognized for its striking **sky-blue color**.

 
 
• 
 
The mushroom contains rare **azulene pigments**, making it one of the most visually distinctive fungi globally.

 
 
• 
 
The **shuttlecock mushroom** (Clathrus delicatus) was recorded for the first time in the **Eastern Ghats** within **Kawal Tiger Reserve**.

 
 
• 
 
The vivid **blue hue** of the Blue Pinkgill is due to the presence of **azulene pigments**, rare in fungi.
